# roadie_integration (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Roadie integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "roadie_integration" "github" {
  slug = "github"
}

output "github_host" {
  value = data.roadie_integration.github.host
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique identifier. Provide either id or slug.
- `slug` (String) The slug identifier. Provide either id or slug.

### Read-Only

- `auth_type` (String)
- `backend_type` (String)
- `burst_capacity` (Number)
- `created_at` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `host` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `requests_per_hour` (Number)
- `requests_per_second` (Number)
- `type` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
